cg21-receipt-relationship.text: One CG21 receipt binds one accepted fold and two distinct refusal legs, each with its own accepted control.

fold-observation-fields.text: The fold observation names policies, key, transaction, mint, destination, delivered asset and each fine transaction conjunct.

refusal-leg-fields.text: Each refusal leg names its rejected transaction, failing hashes, optional trace, accepted control and distinguisher.

validation-invariants.text: CG21 fields are mandatory, keyed-mint keys are distinct, observations share the candidate-bound run and absent traces stay absent.
